parts.gloss: that which is said to be

words.gloss: of those said to be good

literal: Among those things said to be good, the best indeed is the restraint of not speaking before elders.
translation: Among all things that are considered good, the restraint of not speaking before wise elders is indeed the best.
modern: நன்மை என்று சொல்லப்பட்டவற்றுள்ளும் மிகச் சிறந்தது, அறிவு முதிர்ந்த பெரியோர்களுக்கு முன்னால் முந்திக்கொண்டு பேசாமல் அடங்கியிருக்கும் அடக்கமே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the virtue of respectful silence and restraint in the presence of wise elders. The word 'முதுவர்' refers to those who are mature in both age and wisdom. 'முந்து கிளவாச் செறிவு' describes the self-control of not rushing to speak before these elders have spoken. The author declares that among all virtues considered good, this quiet deference is the most excellent.
